annual_fee.note: The current card launched 2018-06-28; the draft gives no separate start date for the $95 fee.

benefits.name: Discoverist status
benefits.enrollment_how: Link a Hyatt account to the card.
benefits.note: Held while the card remains eligible.

benefits.name: Annual elite-night credits
benefits.qualifying: Credited to the primary cardholder's Hyatt account: 5 qualifying nights on opening and each calendar year.
benefits.note: The annual credit generally arrives within 8 weeks of January 1.

benefits.name: Spending elite-night credits
benefits.qualifying: 2 elite nights per $5,000 of eligible net purchases.
benefits.note: No annual cap; progress carries across year-end.

benefits.name: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.enrollment_how: Activate with an eligible card by 2027-12-31.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible DoorDash and Caviar orders; order minimums apply.
benefits.note: 12 complimentary months from one activation. Membership benefit, not a statement credit.

benefits.name: DoorDash nonrestaurant discount
benefits.enrollment_how: Needs an active eligible DashPass; select the promotion.
benefits.qualifying: Eligible grocery, retail and other nonrestaurant orders.
benefits.note: Unused amount expires each quarter. Applied at checkout, so the bank sees the net charge.

benefits.name: Early award booking
benefits.qualifying: Eligible Hyatt award inventory, bookable up to 13 months ahead.

certificates.name: Anniversary free night
certificates.value_cap: One night in a Category 1-4 standard room; not a fixed points allowance, and points cannot be added to make it a Category 5 certificate.
certificates.note: Issued each card anniversary to the linked Hyatt account; allow up to about 10 weeks. Eligible standard-room award inventory only; excluded properties and brands apply; the stay must be completed within validity.

certificates.name: Spending free night
certificates.value_cap: One night in a Category 1-4 standard room; not a fixed points allowance, and points cannot be added to make it a Category 5 certificate.
certificates.note: Earned at $15,000 of eligible net purchases in a calendar year (spend resets January 1); allow up to about 8 weeks after qualifying. Same use rules as the anniversary night.

thresholds.unlocks: 2 qualifying Hyatt elite nights per $5,000 of eligible net purchases; no annual cap, and the progress counter carries over across year-end (unlike the business card's calendar-year counter).
